evidence.title: Ona Codex Agent

evidence.finding: Prompts/commands/PR/report steps run in isolated dev environments. Manual/schedule/PR/webhook triggers; laptop need not be on. Core/Enterprise limits apply.

evidence.finding: Sequential prompt/command/PR/report steps in one environment. Service accounts for scheduled work with permission checks. Disable preserves config/history but prevents new runs.

evidence.finding: Core 50 automations/10 parallel/50 total actions; Enterprise unlimited definitions/25 parallel/1000 total system ceiling. Webhook sources Enterprise; Core GitHub PR triggers available.

evidence.title: Ona Persistent storage
evidence.finding: VM disk persists stop/start. Repository bind mount preserves uncommitted code on rebuild; other filesystem recreated unless mounted. Prebuilds snapshot environment.

evidence.title: Ona Archive and deletion
evidence.finding: Core archives after 3 inactive days then deletes after 4 more; Enterprise timings configurable including never-delete. Deleted content permanently removed.

evidence.title: Ona CLI
evidence.finding: Product-owned ona CLI with macOS/Linux/Windows downloads manages environments (create/start/stop/delete), SSH, ports, prebuilds, webhooks and environment tasks/services; browser login and personal access token authentication documented.

evidence.title: Ona SSO

evidence.title: Ona docs: Overview
evidence.finding: New customer signup is closed; existing customers and new members of existing organizations continue. Existing organizations run Ona in their own VPC on AWS or GCP and can start a single interactive session or run agents on a schedule, on PR events or from the issue tracker. Issues can be assigned to Ona in Linear. Environments are ephemeral and isolated, with SSO, OIDC and SCIM built in.

evidence.title: Ona docs: Linear
evidence.locator: What agents can do with Linear; Start a session from an issue
evidence.finding: Once connected, agents can create Linear issues, move issues to In Progress and Done, search issues and add comments that document findings or link PRs. Mentioning the agent in an issue comment or delegating (assigning) the issue to Ona starts a session that reads the issue and posts progress back; the session runs under the user's identity, or as the assignee when assigned on someone's behalf.

evidence.finding: A built-in browser runs inside the environment; when Ona AI is enabled users can share page state with Ona and send screenshots from the Browser tab into the conversation (Annotate browser, Send screenshot to Ona). Enterprise admins can disable the browser by policy.

evidence.title: Ona docs: Archive & auto-delete
evidence.finding: Core: stopped environments archive after 3 days and auto-delete 4 days after archival. Enterprise: archive after 3 days by default, configurable 1-30 days; auto-delete configurable 1-4 weeks or never. The ona CLI archives an environment with ona environment archive <id-or-name>.

evidence.title: Ona docs: Architecture overview
evidence.finding: The management plane (auth, organizations, guardrail enforcement, runner coordination, dashboard and API) is hosted by Ona. Runners in the customer's AWS or GCP handle environment provisioning, source access, secrets, agent execution and builds.

evidence.title: Ona docs: Veto
evidence.locator: Intro; Capabilities (executable deny list); Kernel-level enforcement
evidence.finding: Veto runs as a Linux Security Module inside the environment kernel and blocks admin-listed binaries by content hash (rename- and symlink-resistant); the agent cannot unload it or change its configuration. Vendor statement; no independent security test.

evidence.title: Ona docs: User budgets
evidence.finding: Enterprise user budgets give each member a monthly credit or BYOK cost allowance shown on Cost & Budgets. Budgets are soft: for reporting and visibility, not enforced at usage time; users over budget can keep creating environments and running agents.

evidence.title: Ona docs: Teams
evidence.finding: Team credit budgets are soft, used for reporting and alerting only and not enforced at usage time.

evidence.title: Ona docs: Auto-stop timeout
evidence.locator: Configuration; Effect on users; Set a default auto-stop timeout
evidence.finding: Environments auto-stop after an idle timeout: 30 minutes by default; users choose 30 minutes, 1 hour, 3 hours, 8 hours or Never, capped by an organization maximum policy (Core plan or higher).

evidence.title: Ona docs: Insights
evidence.finding: Enterprise Insights shows Velocity, AI Adoption and Platform usage, filterable by date range, project and team, aggregated daily or weekly; Velocity and AI Adoption need per-project enablement.

evidence.title: Ona docs: AI cost usage API
evidence.locator: Intro; Ona Intelligence or BYOK table
evidence.finding: Enterprise AI cost usage API exposes BYOK spend: organization totals, per-team and per-user attribution with budgets and a daily time series, for export to finance tools. Ona Intelligence credit usage has a separate usage API.

evidence.title: Ona docs: Report step
evidence.finding: A Report step defines typed outputs that the agent extracts by prompt or command after earlier steps; results appear in a table with CSV export on the execution summary, only for executions with more than one action.

evidence.title: Ona docs: Sharing resources
evidence.locator: Share a project (role table); Remove access
evidence.finding: Enterprise project admins share projects with users, groups or everyone as User (view and use), Editor (settings, secrets, environment classes) or Admin (full control including sharing and deletion); the creator becomes admin.

evidence.title: Ona docs: Command deny list
evidence.locator: How it works; Pattern matching; Configuration
evidence.finding: Admins add command patterns in Settings > Agents > Policies; a matching agent command is blocked with an error message. Slash commands are not filtered; changes apply to new agent sessions.

evidence.title: Ona Cloud is shutting down on October 31, 2026
evidence.finding: Ona Cloud wound down on October 31, 2026. To save work, ask the agent to commit and push code and back up other files separately. All October payments and unused purchased credits at shutdown are refunded. Environments do not move to Codex automatically.

evidence.title: Ona docs: Ona Cloud
evidence.finding: Ona Cloud is no longer available; Enterprise organizations continue using runners in their own AWS or GCP infrastructure.

evidence.title: Ona Trust Center (SafeBase)
evidence.locator: Compliance; Documents (SOC 2 Report, private, Get access); Legal (Subprocessors)
evidence.finding: The Trust Center lists GDPR, SOC 2 and EU AI Act under Compliance and a SOC 2 Report among documents that require Get access; Legal lists a Subprocessors item whose contents were not shown in the fetched page. Report contents were not inspected.

evidence.title: Ona pricing (contact sales)
evidence.finding: The pricing URL now serves a contact-sales form (name, work email, company, engineer count, cloud provider). It lists no plan, price, currency, seat terms or trial.

evidence.title: Privacy policy · Ona
evidence.locator: website analytics sections (Google Analytics, Segment, Mixpanel) and use of personal data from the Ona Service
evidence.finding: The policy lists Google Analytics, Segment and Mixpanel for website analytics, each deactivatable via the browser's Do Not Track setting, and says Ona may analyze personal data from use of the Ona Service to improve it. It does not say whether the Ona web app, desktop app, Ona CLI or VS Code extension send usage telemetry, or describe an in-product control.

evidence.title: Gitpod CLI (Ona docs)
evidence.finding: The legacy Gitpod workspace CLI sends anonymous telemetry (command name, exception information, anonymous machine ID) by default; 'gitpod config set --telemetry=false' or DO_NOT_TRACK disables it. The current Ona CLI reference (ona.com/docs/ona/reference/cli.md) and VS Code extension page do not mention telemetry.
